entities.name: Lower bound timer value
entities.description: An information element that provides a minimum time value for an entry added to the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

entities.name: PLMN not allowed to operate at the present UE location
entities.description: 5GMM cause value #78 indicating that the PLMN is not allowed to operate at the present UE location.

entities.name: List of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location
entities.description: A list maintained by the UE containing PLMNs that are not allowed to operate at the current UE location.

relations.description: The lower bound timer value IE may be included when the 5GMM cause is set to #78.
The lower bound timer value provides a minimum time value for an entry added to the list of PLMNs not allowed to operate at the present UE location.
